title: session.cancel
description: Cancels the current turn, or turnId's while it is still the current one (a named turn that is not is stale_turn). Accepted with nothing to cancel only while an ask is pending or a foreign turn runs; otherwise not_accepting. A failure the cancel ran into comes back as the error, with this method's errorResult as data.result.

outcome.description: requested: the cancel reached the agent and the turn had not yet ended; settled: it had ended, or there was no turn of craze's own; unknown: the call gave up where a cancel may already have been written.

turn.description: The turn the cancel was held against, "" with no turn of craze's own running.

reported.description: The failure beside this result was also published, as a send-now delta: a client that words failures from deltas must not word it again.

errorResult.description: data.result beside a cancel's error: the cancel's result.
